text:
lucy-recruiter: Heads up  Pravin accepted offer (start 09/02) but client asked him to work onsite at their SF office starting week 2. Hes currently H-1B with worksite limited to Redwood SF HQ. Need legal + payroll: does this require an H-1B amendment or LCA posting?

pravin-engineering: Hi all  client asked for Monday morning onsite pairing. I can do two weeks remote then onsite, but want to make sure we're compliant.

sara-legal: Short answer: a material change to worksite outside the geographic area covered by the certified LCA typically requires a new LCA and potentially an H-1B amendment filing, depending on travel frequency and duration. Client SF office is within CA but if the LCA covers a different metro area we need to post a new LCA for the SF worksite.

ashley-peopleops: Timeline question  how long to get an LCA posted and amendment filed? We need to know if we can let him go onsite in week 2 or need to delay.

mike-payroll: Payroll needs final determination before we can change work location for tax withholding and local benefits. Also state tax registration may be required if employee will be treated as resident in another state for payroll.

sara-legal: LCA posting: we can prepare and post within 3 business days if we have the exact SF address. LCA certification from DOL typically ~7 business days but can be faster. H-1B amendment filing (if required) can be filed concurrently with an RFE risk; premium processing can get adjudication in ~15 calendar days but not guaranteed.

client-eng: From client side: they prefer him onsite week 2 for ramp pairing but can accept week 3 if needed. They really want in-person for at least first month.

lucy-recruiter: Pravin can provide exact client office address. Uploading now.

onboard-bot: Document upload received: client_address_pravin.pdf. Status: pending review.

pravin-engineering: Uploaded. Also note I will be traveling from another state to SF; it's not permanent; plan is on-site Mon-Fri for month 1 then hybrid.

sara-legal: That pattern looks like a new worksite. We'll proceed with LCA posting for the client site. We will advise on amendment necessity after certification. If amendment needed, we recommend filing with premium processing to avoid delay.

ashley-peopleops: Action items: 1) Legal to prepare LCA and posting copy; 2) Payroll to hold on state withholding change until legal confirms amendment; 3) IT to hold laptop shipping until we have final worksite flag confirmed.

mike-payroll: A note on benefits: if employee spends majority of time in CA after start, CA state tax may apply. Please capture start date at SF site for payroll. Also need employee acknowledgement for travel expense reimbursements.

it-bot: IT note: if onsite at client, enable device enrollment for client network; otherwise keep MDM restrictions.

sara-legal: We'll draft the LCA posting text and share for 10-day notice. Posting requirement: conspicuous internal notice at Redwood HQ and external notice via our public job board. Confirm if client allows Redwood to post their site name.

client-eng: OK to use client name in public LCA posting.

lucy-recruiter: I'll post notices and cc team. Pravin: do you want to delay onsite until we have certified LCA or go for week 3?

pravin-engineering: I'd prefer to start onsite week 3 if that makes paperwork smoother. Week 2 remote is fine.

ashley-peopleops: Great  we'll update the start plan: official hire 09/02 remote; onsite week 3 pending LCA. Will confirm by Friday.

onboard-bot: LCA draft ready: https://onboard.redwood.ai/lca/1900123456.

sara-legal: Final: LCA posted 2024-08-20, certification expected 2024-08-28. If certified, we'll file amendment with premium processing on 2024-08-29. Marking thread in-progress.
